Indicator_Name: Proportion of the population living below the international poverty line by sex, age, employment status and geographic location (urban/rural)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.1.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Headcount against an income threshold, from household survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population living below the national poverty line, by sex and age
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.2.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Headcount against a national income threshold, from household survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of men, women and children of all ages living in poverty in all its dimensions according to national definitions
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.2.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Multidimensional poverty headcount from survey data against national definitions. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population covered by social protection floors/systems, by sex, distinguishing children, unemployed persons, older persons, persons with disabilities, pregnant women, newborns, work-injury victims and the poor and the vulnerable
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.3.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Administrative count of social protection coverage. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population living in households with access to basic services
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.4.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Survey-based count of households with access to basic services. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of total adult population with secure tenure rights to land, (a) with legally recognized documentation, and (b) who perceive their rights to land as secure, by sex and type of tenure
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.4.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Tenure documentation and perception survey. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Number of deaths, missing persons and directly affected persons attributed to disasters per 100,000 population
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.5.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: disaster mortality and affected persons, where hydrometeorological hazards dominate the count and the Sendai methodology disaggregates by hazard type including climatological, meteorological and hydrological. Weather drives the value but is not itself an input to the calculation. Consistent with [GBF-180].

Indicator_Name: Direct economic loss attributed to disasters in relation to global gross domestic product (GDP)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.5.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Direct economic loss from disasters, on the same Sendai hazard classification as 1.5.1: weather-driven events dominate the loss total, but loss is computed from damage assessment rather than from weather data.

Indicator_Name: Number of countries that adopt and implement national disaster risk reduction strategies in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.5.3. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Count of countries with national DRR strategies. no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A).

Indicator_Name: Proportion of local governments that adopt and implement local disaster risk reduction strategies in line with national disaster risk reduction strategies
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.5.4. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Count of local governments with DRR strategies. no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A).

Indicator_Name: Total official development assistance grants from all donors that focus on poverty reduction as a share of the recipient country’s gross national income
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.a.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Official development assistance flows as a share of recipient GNI. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of total government spending on essential services (education, health and social protection)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.a.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Government expenditure shares. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Pro-poor public social spending
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 1.b.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Public social spending measure. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Prevalence of undernourishment
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.1.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: FAO prevalence of undernourishment is modelled from dietary energy supply, which is built on crop and livestock production data; inter-annual weather moves production and therefore the estimate.

Indicator_Name: Prevalence of moderate or severe food insecurity in the population, based on the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.1.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Experience-based food insecurity scale. Weather data are not used, but harvest and price shocks driven by inter-annual weather move the measured prevalence.

Indicator_Name: Prevalence of stunting (height for age <-2 standard deviation from the median of the World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards) among children under 5 years of age
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.2.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Child stunting reflects chronic nutrition over years; climate acts only as a distant background driver of food availability.

Indicator_Name: Prevalence of malnutrition (weight for height >+2 or <-2 standard deviation from the median of the WHO Child Growth Standards) among children under 5 years of age, by type (wasting and overweight)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.2.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Child wasting responds acutely to seasonal and drought-driven food shortage, so inter-annual weather moves the value, though no weather data enter the calculation.

Indicator_Name: Prevalence of anaemia in women aged 15 to 49 years, by pregnancy status (percentage)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.2.3. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Anaemia prevalence from health survey and biomarker data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Volume of production per labour unit by classes of farming/pastoral/forestry enterprise size
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.3.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: production per labour unit. Output varies with weather, but the indicator is constructed from production and labour statistics. Consistent with [GBF-170].

Indicator_Name: Average income of small-scale food producers, by sex and indigenous status
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.3.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: income of small-scale food producers, from income and production statistics. Consistent with [GBF-073].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of agricultural area under productive and sustainable agriculture
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.4.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: an 11-sub-indicator composite of farm sustainability, assessed by survey rather than from climate data. Consistent with [GBF-020].

Indicator_Name: Number of plant and animal genetic resources for food and agriculture secured in either medium- or long-term conservation facilities
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.5.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: count of accessions held in ex situ conservation facilities. Administrative record. Consistent with [GBF-060].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of local breeds classified as being at risk of extinction
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.5.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: proportion of local breeds at risk, from breed population registers. Consistent with [GBF-063].

Indicator_Name: The agriculture orientation index for government expenditures
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Finance | Governance, Society & Data
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.a.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Ratio of agriculture expenditure share to agriculture GDP share. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Total official flows (official development assistance plus other official flows) to the agriculture sector
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.a.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Official flows to the agriculture sector. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Agricultural export subsidies
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Trade & Industry | Finance
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.b.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Reported agricultural export subsidies. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Indicator of food price anomalies
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Trade & Industry | Finance
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 2.c.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: The food price anomaly indicator is a statistical measure of price volatility; weather-driven supply shocks are a principal cause of the anomalies it detects, so inter-annual weather moves the value.

Indicator_Name: (a) Proportion of total agricultural population with ownership or secure rights over agricultural land, by sex; and (b) share of women among owners or rights-bearers of agricultural land, by type of tenure
Policy_Sector: Land Use & Agriculture | Governance, Society & Data
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 5.a.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Agricultural land ownership and rights by sex, from survey and tenure records. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of countries where the legal framework (including customary law) guarantees women’s equal rights to land ownership and/or control
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 5.a.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: legal framework assessment. Consistent with [GBF-200].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of individuals who own a mobile telephone, by sex
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 5.b.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Mobile telephone ownership by sex, from survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of countries with systems to track and make public allocations for gender equality and women’s empowerment
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 5.c.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: count of countries with gender budget tracking systems. Consistent with [GBF-198].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population using safely managed drinking water services
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.1.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: service-level classification of drinking water supply, from household survey and provider records rather than from hydrology. Consistent with [GBF-178].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population using (a) safely managed sanitation services and (b) a hand-washing facility with soap and water
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.2.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Service-level classification of sanitation and handwashing facilities, from survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of domestic and industrial wastewater flows safely treated
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.3.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: proportion of wastewater flows safely treated, from treatment plant records. Consistent with [GBF-067].

Indicator_Name: Proportion of bodies of water with good ambient water quality
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.3.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: ambient water quality classification from monitoring data. Measured concentrations vary with flow, temperature and dilution, so inter-annual weather moves the value. Consistent with [GBF-075].

Indicator_Name: Change in water-use efficiency over time
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.4.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: value added per volume of water withdrawn. Withdrawals, particularly for irrigation, respond to inter-annual rainfall. Consistent with [GBF-185].

Indicator_Name: Level of water stress: freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.4.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: the denominator is total renewable freshwater resources, computed from precipitation and runoff, so climatic data are a direct input to the calculation. Consistent with [GBF-076].

Indicator_Name: Degree of integrated water resources management
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.5.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Questionnaire-based score of integrated water resources management. The governed subject is a climate-driven physical system, but the measure is an administrative assessment.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of transboundary basin area with an operational arrangement for water cooperation
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.5.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: A: proportion of transboundary basin area under an operational cooperation arrangement. Administrative count. Consistent with [GBF-140].

Indicator_Name: Change in the extent of water-related ecosystems over time
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.6.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Surface-water extent from satellite time series; precipitation moves it strongly year to year, but no climate data enter the classification (Legend 2, rules D and G; aligned with [IPBES-N-018], [BIP-017], [GBF-102]).

Indicator_Name: Amount of water- and sanitation-related official development assistance that is part of a government-coordinated spending plan
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.a.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Water and sanitation official development assistance within a coordinated spending plan. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of local administrative units with established and operational policies and procedures for participation of local communities in water and sanitation management
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 6.b.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Count of local administrative units with participation procedures. Administrative count.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population with access to electricity
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.1.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Proportion of population with an electricity connection, from survey and utility records. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of population with primary reliance on clean fuels and technology
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.1.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Primary cooking and heating fuel from household survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Renewable energy share in the total final energy consumption
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.2.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Renewable share of total final energy consumption. Hydro, wind and solar output vary with weather year to year, so inter-annual weather moves the measured share.

Indicator_Name: Energy intensity measured in terms of primary energy and GDP
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.3.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Primary energy per unit of GDP; heating and cooling demand move it modestly with weather but weather is not an input (Legend 1, rules C and G; aligned with [IND-C-055], [IND-B-169]).

Indicator_Name: International financial flows to developing countries in support of clean energy research and development and renewable energy production, including in hybrid systems
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.a.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: International financial flows for clean energy research and production. Financial accounting only.

Indicator_Name: Installed renewable energy-generating capacity in developing countries (in watts per capita)
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 7.b.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Installed renewable capacity per capita is a stock of plant from registration data; no climate or weather data enter the calculation and weather does not move the value. Climate relevance of the subject is carried by Policy_Sector, not by this score (rule A). Aligned with [IND-C-006] to [IND-C-008].

Indicator_Name: Annual growth rate of real GDP per capita
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 8.1.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Real GDP per capita growth. Climate acts as a background driver of macroeconomic performance but no climate data enter national accounts.

Indicator_Name: Annual growth rate of real GDP per employed person
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 8.2.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Real GDP per employed person. Climate is a background driver only.

Indicator_Name: Proportion of informal employment in total employment, by sector and sex
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 8.3.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Informal employment share from labour force survey data. No climate or weather input.

Indicator_Name: Material footprint, material footprint per capita, and material footprint per GDP
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 8.4.1. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
Climate_Rationale: Material footprint from material flow accounts; the biomass component reflects weather-sensitive harvests, but the account is built from trade and production statistics.

Indicator_Name: Domestic material consumption, domestic material consumption per capita, and domestic material consumption per GDP
Source_Reference: UN General Assembly Resolution A/RES/71/313, Annex – Global Indicator Framework for the SDGs (2017). Indicator 8.4.2. https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/indicators/indicators-list/
Data_Source: UN Statistics Division – SDG Global Database (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal)
